//: Azure Static Web Apps routing for the ShipMate frontend (feat/azure-deploy). The SPA keeps VITE_API_BASE at its '/api' default and SWA proxies /api/* to the backend Container App, so no API host is baked into the bundle. Set BACKEND_ORIGIN below to the deployed backend URL (e.g. https://shipmate-api.<region>.azurecontainerapps.io). Everything else falls through to index.html for client-side routing (incl. the /github/callback OAuth route).
